title: CHAPTER FOUR. On the states of Christ: humiliation and exaltation
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): On ye states belonging toward Christ. — CHAPTER FOUR. — namely belonging toward humiliation and belonging toward exaltation. — Ye states belonging toward Christ that were required around ye imposition and execution belonging toward these offices, so that He might bear ye name Savior according toward ye will belonging toward His Father, stand as two: — To ye state belonging toward humiliation belong ye passion, crucifixion, death, burial, and descent toward ye lower regions. — II.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER FOUR. On the states of Christ.

The states of Christ that were required around the imposition and execution of these offices, so that He might bear the name Savior according to the will of His Father, are two: namely of humiliation and of exaltation.
II. To the state of humiliation belong the passion, crucifixion, death, burial, and descent to the lower regions.
source_text: CAPUT QUARTUM, De statibus Christi. STATUS Christi, qui circa impositionem & executionem horum officiorum ad hoc requisiti sunt, ut nomen Salvatoris secundum voluntatem Patris sui gerere possit, duo sunt: HUMILIATIONIS videlicet & EXALTATIONIS. II. Ad statum humiliationis pertinent passio, crucifixio, mors, sepultura, descensus ad inferos.
